dedupe_keys.name: schools of cambodia basic information 2012 with a 2014 update from the ministry of education youth and sport

description: Open Development Cambodia (ODC) publishes school locations and names with basic information (numbers of classes and rooms, teaching and non-teaching staff, total enrolment) for pre-school, primary school, lycée and collège across Cambodia; the 2012 data were established by the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport and contributed by OCHA to the Humanitarian Data Exchange, and the page carries a 2014 school table spatially joined to the 2012 locations; 19 resources in total. Coverage: Cambodia nationally, school years 2012 and 2014; the portal record was last modified on 2022-05-23. Format and access: Shapefile, KML, GeoJSON, CSV, WMS, JPEG, downloadable without registration from the Open Development Cambodia data hub (OD Mekong Datahub); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: the data are a decade old and not a maintained series, the page says the 2014 table was spatially joined to the 2012 school locations, and the files were not opened; the same 2012 layer is also on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Simulation uses: school locations as shelters and critical facilities in flood and storm models, and for accessibility and enrolment-based capacity analysis. Related catalogue records: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) (data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange); Cambodia evacuation sites in Pursat and Oddar Meanchey provinces, 2015 (HDX) (data-cambodia-pursat-oddar-meanchey-evacuation-sites); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
